info.title: Kirana API
info.description: Self-hosted household shopping board. Base path /api/v1, JSON only, HttpOnly sid cookie auth (P4), X-Request-Id on every response, errors in the §7.1 envelope. Refs: PRD §7.

post.summary: Exchange the household passcode for a session cookie

get.summary: Full Home payload; pass since for a delta

patch.summary: Update name, icon, status, ordering or notes

delete.summary: Soft delete a store (409 if it has active items)

post.summary: Add a list item by catalog id or free text (§7.4)
Mark done; 409 unless zero active items (§4.6)

patch.summary: Update qty, unit, category, note, status or sortOrder

delete.summary: Hard delete a list row, returns an undo token

post.summary: Check or uncheck many rows at once
Create a catalog item with optional aliases

get.summary: Full item detail: aliases, defaults, attrs, usage stats (ADR-0003)

patch.summary: Update name, defaults, icon or attrs

delete.summary: Soft delete an item; list rows render as Archived item (INV-6)

post.summary: Add an alias in a known language

patch.summary: Update name, icon, color, scope or sortOrder

delete.summary: Soft delete; entries are reassigned to Other (§7.2 #26)

post.summary: Parse CSV/JSON upload into a diff + signed token (§9.3)

get.summary: Full household dump (json) or per-store list (csv) (§9.4)
